limitations: One known fixture with scripted model responses, not natural-provider ability or a benchmark success rate.
Token usage is synthetic; request deadlines are real local short bounds, not an end-to-end 500-second stress test.
Only synchronous non-streaming JSON guard supported; existing archive SSE partial rules are not streaming support for this runner.
The two forcibly terminated workers have no completed worker manifest or independent scorer; absence of final geometry records is retained.
Initial/state digests are sealed recorded values plus source review, not re-execution or a second private-state decode.
Cancellation integration is during model wait; the lock contention behavior is a separate pure-test result.
